# DuckProtocol (duckpad.fun)

> DuckProtocol is a token launchpad with per-token lending and governance on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) and Ink (chain id 57073). Tokens launch through a bonding curve, an instant Uniswap V4 pool, or a crowdfund. Every pool is a Uniswap V4 pool with fee tier 0, tick spacing 200, and the chain's DuckHookV4 hook, which takes a 2-10% trading fee in the quote currency on buys and sells. All actions are permissionless contract calls; a public REST API serves token, trade, holder and USD price data.

Docs: https://docs.duckpad.fun
App: https://duckpad.fun
API base: https://api.duckpad.fun (routes prefixed /robinhood or /ink)

## Launching a token

Token address must end in 0x8888 (else VanityAddressRequired). Mine userSalt client-side:
- initCodeHash = keccak256(0x3d602d80600a3d3981f3363d3d373d3d3d363d73 ++ DuckTokenImpl ++ 0x5af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3)
- salt = keccak256(abi.encode(address sender, bytes32 userSalt))
- token = last 20 bytes of keccak256(0xff ++ familyContract ++ salt ++ initCodeHash); try userSalt = 0,1,2... until token & 0xffff == 0x8888 (~65k tries)

Fee fields shared by all families (fixed once the pool registers):
- hookFeeBps: 0 (=200), 200, 400, 600, 800 or 1000
- creatorBps + vaultBps + burnBps == 10000 (splits the 70% of each claimed fee left after 25% platform and 5% holders)
- supplyTier: 0..6 = 1B, 10B, 100B, 1T, 10T, 100T, 1Q (token decimals always 18)

Bonding curve: DuckBondingCurve.createToken((string name, string symbol, uint8 supplyTier, uint256 curveBps, uint256 liquidityBps, address quoteToken, uint256 startVirtualQuote, uint256 migrationTargetQuote, uint256 earlyBuyAmount, uint256 hookFeeBps, uint16 creatorBps, uint16 vaultBps, uint16 burnBps, string metaURI, bytes32 salt)) payable returns (address token)
- curveBps + liquidityBps == 10000, curveBps >= 3000, liquidityBps >= 1000 (owner-tunable minimums)
- 0 < startVirtualQuote < migrationTargetQuote, in quote units
- Native quote: value = creationFee() + optional creator buy. ERC-20 quote: value = creationFee() exactly; earlyBuyAmount pulled via transferFrom (approve first). Quote must be native or quoteTokenAllowed.
- Transfers are locked to the curve until migration. Emits TokenCreated.

Instant: DuckLauncher.launch((string name, string symbol, string metaURI, address feeWallet, address positionManager, address quoteToken, bytes32 vanitySalt, uint8 supplyTier, uint256 launchMarketCap, uint256 minQuoteOut, uint256 minTokensOut, uint256 hookFeeBps, uint16 creatorBps, uint16 vaultBps, uint16 burnBps, bool revertOnInstantBuyFailure)) payable returns (address token, bytes32 poolId)
- positionManager = the chain's V4 PositionManager; feeWallet = pool creator (address(0) = sender); any quote token allowed
- launchMarketCap = opening FDV in quote units; value = launchFee() + optional instant buy in native ETH (routed ETH -> quote -> token). Emits TokenLaunched.

Crowdfund: DuckCrowdfund.launch(string name, string symbol, string metaURI, address dexQuoteAsset, uint256 goal, uint256 startTime, bytes32 vanitySalt, uint256 hookFeeBps, uint16 creatorBps, uint16 vaultBps, uint16 burnBps, uint8 supplyTier) payable returns (uint256 campaignId, address token)
- value == campaignFee() exactly; deadline = startTime + campaignDuration(); goal in dexQuoteAsset units
- contribute(campaignId, amount): native campaigns send value; ERC-20 campaigns approve and pass amount with no value
- After the deadline: finalize(campaignId), then claim(campaignId) on success or claimRefund(campaignId) on a missed goal

## Trading

Before migration (curve token, getTokenConfig(token).migrated == false or API hasPool false):
- Preview: DuckBondingCurveViews.getAmountOut(token, quoteIn) -> (tokensOut, feeQuote); getAmountOutSell(token, tokensIn) -> (quoteOut, feeQuote)
- DuckBondingCurve.buy(token, amountIn, minOut, deadline): native quote sends value (amountIn ignored); ERC-20 quote approves the curve, passes amountIn, no value
- DuckBondingCurve.sell(token, tokensIn, minQuoteOut, deadline) after approving the curve
- buyWithNative(token, minQuoteOut, minOut, deadline) buys an ERC-20-quoted curve token with ETH
- 1% curve fee. The buy reaching migrationTarget attempts migration; otherwise anyone may call migrate(token)

With a pool (migrated curve token, instant token, successful crowdfund):
- PoolKey: currency0 < currency1 by address (native = address(0)), fee 0, tickSpacing 200, hooks = token's hook (API `hook`)
- Quote: V4Quoter.quoteExactInputSingle((poolKey, bool zeroForOne, uint128 exactAmount, bytes hookData)) -> (amountOut, gasEstimate); includes the hook fee
- Swap: UniversalRouter.execute(bytes commands = 0x10, bytes[] inputs, uint256 deadline); input = abi.encode(bytes actions = 0x060c0f, bytes[] [swapParams, abi.encode(currencyIn, amountIn), abi.encode(currencyOut, minOut)])
- swapParams on Ink: abi.encode((poolKey, bool zeroForOne, uint128 amountIn, uint128 amountOutMinimum, bytes hookData))
- swapParams on Robinhood Chain: abi.encode((poolKey, bool zeroForOne, uint128 amountIn, uint128 amountOutMinimum, uint256 minHopPriceX36, bytes hookData)) -- extra field, pass 0
- Native input: send value = amountIn. ERC-20 input: approve Permit2, then Permit2.approve(token, UniversalRouter, amount, expiration)
- Exact-input only (ExactOutputNotSupported). A second swap on the same pool from the same tx.origin in the same block reverts (SameBlockSwap)

## Fees and permissionless triggers

- DuckHookV4.claimFees(bytes32 poolId): pays accruedFees(poolId) as 25% platform, 5% holder rewards, 70% creator/vault/burn. A caller other than the creator receives 1% of the claimed amount (out of the platform share)
- DuckToken.processBatch(): pays holder rewards; due when distributing() or now >= roundStart() + DISTRIBUTION_INTERVAL() (12h). Up to 500 holders per call. Eligibility: >= 0.25% of total supply; contracts, dead address and PoolManager excluded; weighted by time-held balance
- DuckVault.triggerBuyback(): when pendingBuyback() > 0, buys and burns the token
- DuckHookV4.setFeeSplits(poolId, (address wallet, uint16 bps)[]): creator-only, up to 5 wallets summing to 10000, routes only the creator share
- No LP fee; liquidity is full-range and can't be removed

## REST API

Base https://api.duckpad.fun, 120 requests/minute per IP, JSON, errors as { "error": "..." }.
- GET /{chain}/tokens?family=CURVE|INSTANT|CAMPAIGN&limit&offset
- GET /{chain}/tokens/{address} (includes pool registration)
- GET /{chain}/tokens/{address}/trades?limit&offset -> { items: [{ side, quoteAmount, tokenAmount, priceUSD, volumeUSD, trader, timestamp, txHash }], total }
- GET /{chain}/tokens/{address}/holders?limit&offset -> { items: [{ account, balance }], total }
- GET /{chain}/campaigns, /{chain}/campaigns/{id}
- GET /{chain}/portfolio/{wallet}
- GET /{chain}/price?tokens=addr,addr -> { prices: { addr: usd|null } }
- POST /{chain}/price/convert { quoteToken, usd } -> { raw, decimals, priceUsd }
- GET /{chain}/curve | launcher | crowdfund | hook | vault-factory | vault-config | governor-factory | quote-tokens?family= | stats
- GET /{chain}/vaults, /{chain}/vaults/{token}, /{chain}/governance/proposals?token=, /{chain}/governance/proposals/{id}
- POST /upload/image (multipart "file"), POST /upload/metadata { name, symbol, description, image, socials } -> { cid, ipfsUri, gatewayUrl }

Token fields: id, family, name, symbol, creator, quoteToken, quoteDecimals, totalSupply, burnedSupply, holderCount, hasPool, poolId, hook, hookFeeBps, migrated, raisedQuote, migrationTarget, lastPrice, lastPriceUsd, marketCapUSD, volume24h, volume24hUsd, volumeAllTimeUsd, priceChange24h, priceChange24hUsd, metaUri, imageUrl, socials, createdAt, campaign. USD fields are null when the quote asset has no reference price. Stablecoins (USDG, U on Robinhood; USDT0, USDC.e, USDG on Ink) are valued at $1.

## Key events

- DuckBondingCurve: TokenCreated(address indexed token, address indexed creator, address quoteToken, uint256 totalSupply, uint256 virtualQuote, uint256 migrationTarget); TokenBought(address indexed token, address indexed buyer, uint256 quoteIn, uint256 tokensOut, uint256 raisedQuote); TokenSold(address indexed token, address indexed seller, uint256 tokensIn, uint256 quoteOut, uint256 raisedQuote); TokenMigrated(address indexed token, bytes32 poolId, uint256 liquidityQuote, uint256 liquidityTokens)
- DuckLauncher: TokenLaunched(address indexed token, address indexed creator, address indexed positionManager, address quoteToken, address hook, bytes32 poolId)
- DuckCrowdfund: CampaignCreated(uint256 indexed campaignId, address indexed creator, address indexed token, string name, string symbol, address dexQuoteAsset, uint256 goal, uint256 startTime, uint256 deadline); Contributed; CampaignSucceeded; CampaignFailed; Claimed; Refunded
- DuckHookV4: PoolRegistered(bytes32 indexed poolId, address indexed token, address indexed creator, uint256 hookFeeBps); FeesClaimed(bytes32 indexed poolId, uint256 amount); BuybackBurned; CTOApplied; CTOApproved
- Pool swaps: Uniswap V4 PoolManager Swap events for pool ids from PoolRegistered
